messages:
Riley Nguyen: I opened a small PR to add a Ruby SDK example for emitting trace attributes + a short migration note for the new dashboard schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/931 — would appreciate a quick review on wording and the example payload.
Alex Soto: reading now. for the dashboard migration page, can we include an inline one-liner to map `panel.metrics` -> `panels[].metrics` using jq? saves time for ops teams.
Maya Green: yes, and can we also add a sample minimal dashboard JSON after migration? customers like copy/paste examples.
Riley Nguyen: added both. jq one-liner I used:
```bash
jq '.panels |= map(.metrics = (.metrics // .legacyMetrics))' old.json > new.json
```
Alex Soto: solid. tiny nit: prefer `legacy_metrics` snake_case to match other examples. also, add a short note that `metric.label` moved under `panels[].metrics[].label` in v2.
Maya Green: for the Ruby snippet, include how to attach cost and latency attributes to a span + how to push a metric via OpenTelemetry metrics API. here's a compact example I suggested to Riley: 
```ruby
tracer = OpenTelemetry.tracer_provider.tracer("redwood.docs")
tracer.in_span("generate") do |span|
  span.set_attribute("redwood.cost.token_usd", 0.00087)
  span.set_attribute("redwood.latency.ms", 85)
end
# record metric
meter = OpenTelemetry.meter_provider.meter("redwood")
counter = meter.create_float_counter("redwood_token_cost_usd_total")
counter.add(0.00087, {"model" => "redwood-4"})
```
Riley Nguyen: pushed that example. I also added a small e2e check in docs/tests/trace_example_check.test.sh that curls the preview and greps for `redwood.cost.token_usd` so CI will catch regressions.
docs-bot: Preview build available: https://deploy-preview-931--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Sandbox endpoint for example trace: https://sandbox-931.redwood-inference.internal/example/trace (requires Authorization header) — test runner hit it and returned 200.
Alex Soto: one more thought: include a short paragraph advising customers to map trace attributes to their APM/trace UI as numeric fields (not strings) and include an example Grafana Loki query for trace logs referencing the attribute.
Maya Green: added a small note and a sample Loki line filter: `|= "redwood.cost.token_usd"` to find traces with cost attributes. also fixed a stale link to the dashboard schema (link fix).
Riley Nguyen: thanks both. planning to merge after one more engineering review tomorrow morning. :rocket:
